_doc: Bonus chest keys on top of the carrier quota (docs/decisions/0007-keys-and-cover.md, scripts/match/key_bonus.gd). Odds are chances per source; a {odds, two} source gives 2 keys on 'two' of its hits. Scaled x1.2 when the Hollow Crown went from 25 to 30 chests, to keep the share. Low on purpose, so a spare key feels like luck. Rolled on the keys' own seeded stream (seed_add), so no other loot shifts. Target: 20-30% more keys than chests on an average match (--keys-check measures it). Keys are never sold in shops.
